MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.error: Counts places from the left instead of from the ones, so names the wrong place in numbers with different digit counts.

example.question: In 4,206,315 which place is the digit 2 in?
example.wrong_answer: tens (the second place, counted from the left)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.cause: Reads the number like a sentence and numbers the digits in order.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.reveals: Name the place of the same digit in two numbers of different length.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.help: Write the number on a place value chart from the ones place leftwards.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.error: Skips a zero when naming places, so the digits after it are placed one too low.

example.question: In 3,050,600 which place is the 5 in?
example.wrong_answer: hundred thousands (the zero after the 3 was skipped)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.cause: Treats zero as nothing instead of a place holder.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.reveals: A number with several zeros and a question about the digit after them.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.help: Use a place value chart with an empty column filled with 0.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.PLACE_VALUE.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.error: Gives the place name or the digit when asked for the total value.

example.question: What is the total value of 7 in 4,370,215?

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.cause: Place value and total value are used as the same thing.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.reveals: A total value question where the digit is also the answer.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.help: Expand the number: 4,000,000 + 300,000 + 70,000 ... and read off the term.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.error: Writes one zero too many or too few after the digit when working out total value.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.cause: Counts zeros in the number instead of the places to the right of the digit.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.reveals: Distractors ten times larger and ten times smaller.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.help: Count the places to the right of the digit on the chart, then write that many zeros.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.TOTAL_VALUE.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.error: Joins the parts as they are said, leaving out the zeros that fill a group of three.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.cause: Does not know that each group after the millions needs three digits.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.reveals: Parts where the thousands group has fewer than three digits.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.help: Write each part in its own column group of a place value chart before joining.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.error: Puts the thousands and the units groups in the wrong order.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.cause: Writes the smaller group first because it is smaller.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.reveals: An option with the groups swapped.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.help: Read the number aloud from the left and tick each group off as it is written.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SYMBOLS_MIL.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.error: Leaves out the hundreds word or the word thousand when reading a five-digit number.

example.question: Write 45,320 in words.
example.correct_answer: forty-five thousand, three hundred and twenty

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.reveals: Numbers with a hundreds digit and a tens digit.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.help: Split the number into thousands and the last three digits, read each, join.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.error: Confuses the teens and the -ty numbers when moving between words and figures.

example.question: Write "thirty thousand and fourteen" in figures.

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.cause: Mixes fourteen and forty because they sound alike.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.reveals: Words with a teen and its -ty partner.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.help: Say the word slowly: -teen ends with the digit, -ty ends with a zero.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.READ_WRITE_.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..error: Orders numbers by their first digit only, ignoring how many digits each has.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..cause: Compares from the left without counting digits first.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..reveals: A four-digit number with a bigger first digit than a five-digit number.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..help: Count the digits first: more digits means a bigger whole number.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..error: Gives the order from largest to smallest when asked for smallest to largest (or the reverse).
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..cause: Does not read the direction word in the question.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..reveals: Items that are marked for the direction.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..help: Underline the direction word (ascending, smallest to largest) before ordering.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ORDER_100K..source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.error: Always drops the hundreds and lower digits to zero, never rounding up.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.cause: Thinks rounding is cutting off the end of the number.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.reveals: A number whose hundreds digit is 5 or more.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.help: Use a number line between two thousands and ask which end is nearer.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.error: Looks at the tens digit, not the hundreds digit, to decide whether to round up.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.cause: Looks at the digit just to the right of the one asked about, taking the wrong place as the one to round to.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.reveals: A number where the hundreds digit is under 5 and the tens digit is 5 or more.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.help: Circle the thousands digit, then look only at the next digit to its right.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.ROUND_NEARE.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.error: Doubles the number instead of multiplying it by itself.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.reveals: The doubled answer as a distractor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.help: Draw a 9 by 9 square of dots and count them.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.error: Squares only the non-zero digit, so the square of a multiple of ten has too few zeros.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.cause: Squares 3 and writes the zero back, or squares 3 and forgets the zero.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.reveals: Squares of multiples of ten with distractors 9 and 90.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.help: Write 30 x 30 as 3 tens x 3 tens = 9 hundreds.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARES_TO_.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.error: Halves the number instead of finding the number that multiplied by itself gives it.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.reveals: Half of the number as a distractor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.help: Ask "which number times itself is 64?" and test 8 x 8.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.error: Takes the root of a square ending in zeros as ten times too big or too small.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.cause: Does not pair the zeros: two zeros in a square become one zero in the root.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.reveals: Roots of 400, 900 and 6,400 with distractors ten times larger.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.help: Square a few multiples of ten and notice the pattern of zeros.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.WHOLE_NUMBERS.SQUARE_ROOT.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.error: Forgets the zero in the ones place when multiplying by the tens digit, so the second partial product is ten times too small.

example.question: 2,314 x 23
example.wrong_answer: 11,570 (the row for the 2 tens was not shifted: 6,942 + 4,628)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.cause: Does not remember that the 2 in 23 stands for 20.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.reveals: Distractor with the second row shifted wrongly.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.help: Multiply by 3, then by 20 (write the zero first), then add.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.error: Adds the carried digit before multiplying, or forgets it, in a long product.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.cause: Carries are held in the head and lost.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.help: Write the carries small above the next digit and cross each one off when used.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.error: Multiplies only by the ones digit of the two-digit number.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.cause: Treats a 2-digit multiplier as a 1-digit one.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.reveals: Answer equal to the product by the ones digit.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.help: Break 15 into 10 + 5 and compute both parts.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_4D_BY.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.error: Rounds only one of the two factors, so the estimate is not the usual one.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.reveals: Distractor from rounding only one factor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.help: Rewrite the question with both numbers rounded before multiplying.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.error: Loses a zero when multiplying the rounded tens, so the estimate is ten times too small.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.cause: Multiplies 28 x 7 and does not put back both zeros.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.reveals: Estimate with one zero too few.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.help: Count the zeros in both factors and put the same number on the answer.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.ESTIMATE_P.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.error: Finds an additive rule (the difference between the first two terms) for a multiplying pattern.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.cause: Looks at the difference between terms only.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.reveals: Pattern that grows by a growing amount.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.help: Divide each term by the one before it and see whether the answer stays the same.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.error: Expects the gap between terms to stay the same, so continues a doubling pattern by repeating the last gap.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.cause: Has met adding patterns more often than multiplying ones.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.reveals: Next term from repeating the last gap.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.help: Write the multiplier above each arrow between the terms.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.MULTIPLICATION.MULT_PATTE.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.error: Leaves a zero out of the quotient when a digit of the dividend is too small to divide.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.cause: Brings down the next digit and forgets to write 0 in the answer.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.help: Write a 0 in the answer each time a digit cannot be divided.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.error: Writes the remainder as another digit of the quotient or drops it.

example.wrong_answer: 834 (the remainder 4 written as a digit of the answer)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.cause: Does not know what to do with the leftover.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.help: Check by multiplying back and adding the remainder; it must match the dividend.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.error: Divides the smaller digit by the larger divisor part the wrong way round (for example 4 by 12 as 12 by 4).

example.question: First step of 4,536 / 12
example.wrong_answer: 12 / 4 = 3 (the divisor divided by the first digit)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.cause: Swaps dividend and divisor when the first digit is smaller.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.reveals: Working showing a swapped first step.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.help: Use the first digits that make a number at least as big as the divisor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.DIV_4D_BY_UP_TO_.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.error: Rounds the dividend but not the divisor, so the estimate is awkward and usually wrong.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.help: Round both numbers, then divide the rounded numbers.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.error: Cancels zeros unevenly when dividing rounded numbers, giving an estimate ten times too large or small.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.cause: Crosses a zero off the top only.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.help: Cross the same number of zeros off the dividend and the divisor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.ESTIMATE_QUOTIEN.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.error: Works strictly from left to right whatever the operations are.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.cause: Reads a sum like a sentence.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.reveals: Expression where the left-to-right answer differs.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.help: Ask which operation must be done first and underline it.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.error: Always multiplies before dividing, even when the division comes first.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.reveals: Expression with division written before multiplication.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.help: Work multiplication and division in the order they appear, left to right.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.error: Ignores the brackets and works the line in the order written.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.reveals: Expression with brackets whose left-to-right value differs.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.help: Do what is inside the brackets first; draw a box round it.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.error: Subtracts before multiplying when the subtraction comes first in the line.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.reveals: The left-to-right answer as a distractor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.help: Do the multiplication first; use brackets to show the other reading.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.DIVISION.COMBINED_OPERATI.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.error: Adds the numerators and the denominators.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.cause: Treats the fraction bar like a separator between two whole numbers.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.reveals: The across answer as a distractor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.help: Shade 1/2 and 1/3 of the same bar and show the total is more than 1/2, not 2/5.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.error: Uses the product of the denominators instead of the LCM, so the answer is correct but not in simplest form, or the child stops early.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.cause: Does not look for the smallest common multiple.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.reveals: Answer correct in value but not simplest form.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.help: List multiples of both denominators and choose the smallest shared one.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.error: Changes the denominator to the common one but leaves the numerator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.cause: Remembers "make the bottoms the same" but not "and multiply the top too".
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.help: Multiply top and bottom by the same number every time.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_FRACTIONS_L.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_FRACTI.help: Rename with the LCM first, then subtract only the numerators.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_FRACTI.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_FRACTI.error: Subtracts the numerators without first renaming the second fraction with the common denominator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_FRACTI.help: Rename both fractions with the common denominator before subtracting.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_FRACTI.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.error: Adds the wholes and the fractions but leaves an improper fraction in the answer or drops the extra whole.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.reveals: Answer with an improper fraction part.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.help: After adding, check whether the fraction part is 1 or more; if so, add one to the wholes.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.error: Changes a mixed number to an improper fraction by adding the whole to the numerator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.cause: Adds instead of multiplying whole by the denominator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.help: Multiply the whole by the denominator, then add the numerator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.ADD_MIXED_NUMBE.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.error: In 4 1/4 - 2 3/4 subtracts the smaller fraction from the larger (3/4 - 1/4) instead of renaming a whole.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.cause: Avoids a subtraction that cannot be done.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.reveals: Answer with the fraction parts swapped.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.help: Rename 1 whole as 4/4 so the first fraction becomes 5/4, then subtract.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.error: Renames a whole into the fraction but forgets to take one off the whole number.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.cause: Remembers the borrow but not the reduction.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.help: Write "5 becomes 4" above the whole when renaming.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SUBTRACT_MIXED_.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_NE.error: Gives the opposite (negative) instead of the reciprocal.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_NE.cause: Confuses the two words that sound like "opposite".
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_NE.help: Multiply the pair; the product must be 1.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_NE.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_FL.error: Flips only the numerator or the denominator, or writes the same fraction.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_FL.cause: Is unsure what turning upside down changes.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_FL.reveals: The fraction itself as a distractor.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.RECIPROCAL.M_FL.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.error: Squares the numerator but not the denominator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.cause: Thinks the square only applies to the visible top number.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.help: Write (2/5) x (2/5) and multiply both parts.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.source: a familiar error type in maths education (no single source cited); how often Kenyan learners make it is to be confirmed by a teacher

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.error: Doubles the fraction instead of squaring it.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.help: Draw a square with side 3/4 and shade the 3 by 3 out of 16 small squares.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.SQUARE_OF_FRACT.source: to be confirmed by a teacher (no source yet)

MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.FRACTION_TO_PER.error: Writes the numerator with a percent sign, ignoring the denominator.
MATH.G6.NUMBER.FRACTIONS.FRACTION_TO_PER.cause: Reads the fraction as a number out of 100.
